findings: The relay isolates two broken client pipes after receiving successful NPU responses; remaining clients continue. It also delivers a failed provider response without terminating the service.

The last successful draw preceding the first complete DWM capture uses destination-out on 72 vertices with 76 covered samples, confirming the prior inverse-mask and wide-coordinate fix in the live compositor.

The first rejected DWM draw is a 24 by 24 BGRA texture operation with INV_DEST_ALPHA/ONE/ADD for color and alpha, i.e. destination-over. Its 783792-byte capture is preserved and the previous replay probe rejects this unsupported blend.

Later the worker reports an invalid texture-coordinate or indexable-temporary lookup on DWM sequence 10. Its cause is unresolved; this may be a separate blocker after destination-over support. A rejected pixel shader is also preserved for investigation.

Eight frames are received, including one background-only frame, a uniform dark-gray frame, and three identical frames showing wallpaper and desktop icons without a taskbar, while the sole-display gate is true. The corrected input harness checks a matching receipt before sending Start, then observes black frames before those later partial-desktop frames arrive. No usable desktop or visual input response is verified.
Both owned custom devices are removed successfully. After Control wakes the display, the normal desktop, taskbar and icons are visually restored. Physical Delta has no driver changes or restart.
